metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Corn
metas.note: Corn fields can be found in most of northern Argentina, however they are most common in Córdoba, Buenos Aires and Santiago del Estero.

metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Mendoza Vineyards
metas.note: If you see vineyards with mountains in the west and flatness in the east, you are most likely in the outskirts of Mendoza.

metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Sorghum
metas.note: Fields of sorghum can most commonly be seen in Santa Fe, Córdoba and Buenos Aires. It can be identified by its dark red flowerheads.

metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane plantations are most common in Tucumán, with hotspots appearing in Salta and Jujuy.

metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Sunflower
metas.note: Fields of sunflowers are mainly found in southern Chaco, and less commonly in Buenos Aires and southern Córdoba.

metas.name: Argentina - Agriculture - Tree Plantations
metas.note: The majority of tree plantations in Argentina are located in the Entre Rios province.

metas.name: Australia - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane plantations are very common in Northern Queensland, due to its tropical climate.

metas.name: Brazil - Agriculture - Coffee
metas.note: Coffee beans are by far the most common in Minas Gerais, but also can be found in Espirito Santo and northeastern Sao Paulo.

metas.name: Brazil - Agriculture - Cotton
metas.note: 73% of Cotton Production in Brazil takes place in Mato Grosso. 20% take place in the western border of Bahia. Other minor spots are western Minas Gerais, Southern Goias and Northern MGDS
metas.footer: Brought to my attention by [ODG] Felix

metas.name: Brazil - Agriculture - Eucalyptus Grandis
metas.note: Eucalyptus Grandis, when fully grown, is a very tall tree with plantations all over Brazil. You can find them in both large and very small plantations, as well as randomly growing anywhere. You can see them all over the south, but there are some large plantations in Amapa too.

metas.name: Brazil - Agriculture - Soybeans
metas.note: Soybeans appear as small, leafy soil grown plants. They are most commonly grown in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.

metas.name: Brazil - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane plantations are by far most common in the state of Sao Paulo, and in the coastal north east states, especially Alagoas and Pernambuco.

metas.name: Chile - Agriculture - Vineyards
metas.note: Vineyards are commonly seen in Maule.

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Aracataca Cut Palms
metas.note: These palms where the crown has been cut, are very often found near Aracataca and some smaller towns North of it.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana
metas.note: In general, banana plantation can be found mostly in Quindio and Magdalena, sometimes in Northwest-Antioquia and Cordoba, and rarely in surrounding provinces of Quindio.
metas.footer: Colombia Guide for Geoguessr by vamponcrack

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana - Cloudy Gen 3
metas.note:
Large amounts of banana plants in plantations are commonly found in different areas.

Paired with Cloudy Gen 3 Coverage, they're most common in Northwestern Antioquia.
metas.footer: Colombia Guide for Geoguessr by vamponcrack

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana - Dry
metas.note: In Magdalena you will often see banana plantations in a dry sandy/dirty area with mountains to your east.
metas.footer: Source: Colombia Guide for Geoguessr by vamponcrack

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana - Hedge
metas.note: In Quindio you will commonly find banana plantations behind hedges.
metas.footer: Source: Colombia Guide for Geoguessr by vamponcrack

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana - Small Field / No Hedge
metas.note: In the states surrounding Quindio you will find smaller banana plantations along the road not behind hedges.
metas.footer: Source: Colombia Guide for Geoguessr by vamponcrack

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Coffee
metas.note:
The coffee belt stretches in the valley between Medellin and Cali. In the North, you will only find it near the Venezuelan border.

Olives and Tea have a very similar distribution.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Common Guava
metas.note: Common Guava mostly appears in the valley between the western and the central mountain range in Colombia, but it can also appear in other valleys.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Guadua Bamboo
metas.note: Guadua Bamboo plantations are found mainly in Caldas, but also in the adjecent Tolima, Quindio and Risaralda.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Oil Palms
metas.note: Oilpalms can be found mainly in Meta and Casanare. They are also very common around the 45 near Fundacion and Aracataca. Sometimes, you can find them in Barrancabermeja.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane will mainly be found in Cauca and Valle de Cauca.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Breeding
metas.note: It is not so rare to see cows, horses, or sheep in France in Geoguessr. If that ever happens, you should consider the West of the country (Brittany, Normandy), as well as the mountainous regions (Pyrenees and Alps). This is where you have the most chances to find animals in France in Google Street View.
metas.footer: Source: France Tips for Geoguessr by Guigz

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Corn
metas.note: Corn fields are mostly located in the Western part of the country, as well as in some areas in the East of Paris, and around Lyon and Strasbourg.
metas.footer: Source: France Tips for Geoguessr by Guigz

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Lavender Fields
metas.note: Lavender fields can be found in the southeast, appearing as small grey bushes when not fully grown.

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Salt Farms
metas.note: Salt farms, which appear as flooded trenches with grass medians, are unique to the west coastal islands of Île de Ré and Île d'Oléron as well as the nearby coast, as well as some very niche areas in the South of France (Camargue).
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & France Tips for Geoguessr by Guigz

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Sunflower
metas.note: Sunflowers are mostly found in the southwest of the country, particularly around Toulouse.

metas.name: France - Agriculture - Wine
metas.note: France is the second largest wine producer in the world, with many famed wine regions. The most common include the area around Bordeaux, southern coast and Champagne, East of Paris. Other regions include, but are not limited to, Loire Valley, Alsace and Corsica.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & France Tips for Geoguessr by Guigz

metas.name: Germany - Agriculture - Hop
metas.note: Hop fields are mainly found between Ingolstadt and Landshut - an area called 'Hallertau/Holledau' in Bavaria. There are some minor regions in Thuringia, Saxony-Anhalt and Saxony as well.

metas.name: Germany - Agriculture - Vineyards
metas.note: There are 13 wine regions in Germany. They are mostly concentrated in the southwest of Germany. However, there are a couple regions further east as well, along the border between Thuringia and Saxony-Anhalt, as well as along the Elbe in Saxony.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt, Deutsches Weininstitut

metas.name: Hawaii - Agriculture - Eucalyptus Plantation
metas.note: The north east coast of Hawai'i Island is characterized by planted eucalyptus overlooking the ocean.
metas.footer: Source: Geoguessr Guide to Hawaii by pianoman

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Assam - Corn
metas.note: Within Assam, you can find corn between Guwahati and Nagaon, south of the river.

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Assam - Sugarcane
metas.note: Within Assam, sugarcane is mainly found around Lanka

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Bihar - Tea
metas.note: Within Bihar, tea plantations can be found in the far Northeast.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Canola
metas.note: Canola is mostly found in and around Rajasthan.

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Cotton
metas.note: Cotton is commonly found in the western parts of India, particularly in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Grape
metas.note: Maharashtra is by far the state with the highest grape production in India.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Madhya Pradesh - Sugarcane
metas.note: Within Madhya Pradesh, sugar cane can commonly be found southwest and northeast of the Satpura National Park.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Maharashtra - Cotton
metas.note:
Cotton (within) is mostly found around Nanded, more generally in the middle/eastern part of Maharashtra.

Note by MB: Very unreliable in my experience
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Maharashtra - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane in Maharashtra is mostly central from what I saw.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Oil Palm
metas.note: Oil palm plantations are almost exclusive to Andhra Pradesh and are mostly located around Eluru.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Pineapple
metas.note: Pineapple is very uncommon in India, but if you see it, it's in Bihar in the corridor between Nepal and Bangladesh.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane is most commonly found in the north in and around Uttar Pradesh, and in the southwest.

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Sugarcane - Tamil Nadu
metas.note:
Sugar cane can be found in several areas, the two main ones being near Erode and Thiruvanamalai.

It is also findable in smaller areas between those two big areas, but it is still mainly a northern Tamil Nadu thing.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Tea - Assam
metas.note: Within Assam, Tea is mostly planted in the eastern and in the southern regions. There are also some patches in Western Assam.
metas.footer: Source: Northeast India by Cassa, Alok and the GeoGuessr India community

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Tea - Tamil Nadu
metas.note: Tea plantations in India are mostly located in the northeast and in Kerala, but it spills in one particular area in Tamil Nadu northwest of Coimbatore
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Tea - Tripura
metas.note: Within Tripura, Tea is found along the Bangladeshi border, and along the Assamese border.
metas.footer: Source: Northeast India by Cassa, Alok and the GeoGuessr India community

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Tea - West Bengal
metas.note: Within West Bengal, tea plantations are found near the northern border to Bhutan.
metas.footer: Source: Northeast India by Cassa, Alok and the GeoGuessr India community

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Tea Plantation
metas.note:
Tea plantations can be found in the northeast and the far south.

NOTE: If you find tea plantations in a flat area, you are likely in Assam or northeastern West Bengal, near the Assam border.

metas.name: India - Agriculture - Telangana - Cotton
metas.note:
Cotton fields in Telangana are logically next to the big area that produces the most of it in Maharashtra, so it is gonna be found mostly north-west of the state. You can click in Nizamabad for a good score.

Note by MB: In my experience, it's more common North of Nizamabad.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: Indonesia - Agriculture - Cassava
metas.note: Cassava (Manihot esculenta) can be recognised by its small, hand-shaped leaves. It can be found both in plantations as well as semi-wild in residential areas. It is most commonly seen in Lampung and Java with Lampung being the main hot spot.
metas.footer: Source: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Indonesia - Agriculture - Oil Palms
metas.note: Within Indonesia, oil palm plantations are mostly concentrated in Sumatra and Kalimantan. Palm plantations can rarely be seen in Sulawesi.

metas.name: Indonesia - Agriculture - Rice
metas.note: The majority of rice production is concentrated in Java, but can sometimes be found in other provinces, namely South Sulawesi and South Sumatra. They can rarely be found in other provinces as well.

metas.name: Japan - Agriculture - Red Fields
metas.note: Agricultural fields with red soil are commonly found on several southern islands, most notably on the islands of Miyakojima and Ishigaki in southern Okinawa.

metas.name: Japan - Agriculture - Rice
metas.note:
Rice is mainly produced north of Tokyo. During growth, it resembles straws of grass. And when ready for harvest, brown husks are visible. They are also commonly planted in beds of water.

The regions of Chubu (21%), Kanto (15%), Tohoku (27%), and Hokkaido (7%) make up the majority of production.

metas.name: Japan - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane is almost exclusively found on the islands in southern Kyushu and Okinawa.

metas.name: Japan - Agriculture - Tea
metas.note:
Green tea plants are often grown in hedged rows. You will often see these fans mounted on poles, which serve the purpose of preventing frost from falling on the plants.

The prefectures of Shizuoka (36%) and Kagoshima (34%) make up the majority of the production, with Mie (7%), Miyazaki (4%), and other prefectures (17%) making up the minority.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Blue Agave
metas.note:
Commonly known as the blue agave, A. tequilana is immediately recognisable by its blue, sharply protruding leaves. This is the agave from which tequila is extracted, and it mainly inhabits Jalisco, where it is almost always observed in magnificent fields which can even coalesce into vast shades of blue from a distance.

Similar, but different: A. anguistifolia.

While it is difficult to distinguish them, A. tequilana is noticeably bluer. One other difference is that A. angustifolia is more commonly spotted in isolated groupings than A. tequilana, but expansive fields still exist.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Campeche Fields
metas.note: These red agricultural fields surrounded by dense forests of tropical trees are most common in northern Campeche.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Citrus Tree Plantation
metas.note: The area around Poza Rica in Veracruz features a lot of citrus tree plantations. It is common to see large amounts of these trees grown right on top of the hills.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Oil Palm
metas.note: Oil palm plantations are most common in Chiapas, and occasionally on the outskirts of the state in Veracruz, Tabasco, and Campeche.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Prickly Pear Farm
metas.note: In the northeast most area of State of Mexico, around the town Nopaltepec, they often farm Opuntia in vast plains. Farms of prickly pear are otherwise most commonly found in north east Morelos, where they foreground striking, sculpturally eroded dry hills. These farms can be found randomly elsewhere in the country, but much less commonly; if there is a third most common location for them it would be Guanajuato.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Pulque Agave Field
metas.note: One will often notice scattered farms of A. salmiana, gatherings which stretch limitlessly in neat rows; these will almost always be found around the city of Pachuca in Hidalgo, and rarely more south-east.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Red Agricultural Fields
metas.note: Red agricultural fields are commonly seen in Zacatecas and occasionally southern Durango.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane can be found all over the country, but by far most common in Veracruz.

metas.name: Mexico - Agriculture - Very Dark Fields
metas.note: Extremely dark fields are common in Guanajuato.

metas.name: Peru - Agriculture - Banana Plants
metas.note: Similarly to sugar cane plants, banana plants are generally found in agricultural regions adjacent to the coast in the northern half of the country.

metas.name: Peru - Agriculture - Olive Trees
metas.note: Olive tree plantations can be found in the far southern region of Tacna.

metas.name: Peru - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Most of the sugar cane production is found in the northern coastal regions of Peru near the cities of Chiclayo and Trujillo. Typically you see large fields of sugar cane in these areas. Smaller areas of sugar cane can be found further south in other valleys close to the Pacific coast.

metas.name: Philippines - Agriculture - Banana Plantations
metas.note:
Banana plantations are almost exclusively found in central and southern Mindanao.

NOTE: Wild growing banana plants can be found all over the country, so make sure what you are seeing is an actual plantation before guessing.

metas.name: Philippines - Agriculture - Corn
metas.note: While corn can be found in most of the country, it is most common on northern Luzon and on Mindanao.

metas.name: Philippines - Agriculture - Oil
metas.note: The vast majority of Oil palm plantations are found on Mindanao.

metas.name: Philippines - Agriculture - Pineapple
metas.note: Pineapple plantations are mostly found on Mindanao.

metas.name: Philippines - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: The majority of sugarcane in the Philippines can be found on the islands of Negros and Panay.

metas.name: South Africa - Agriculture - Pine Plantation
metas.note:
Tree plantations that consist mostly of pine are common to the west of Eswatini, and some to the south in KwaZulu-Natal.

NOTE: Pine tree plantations are typically seen within the country of Eswatini itself.

metas.name: South Africa - Agriculture - Sugarcane
metas.note: Sugarcane plantations are most commonly seen in KwaZulu-Natal, mostly along the coast. However, they can also be seen in Mpumalanga on the Mozambique border. For an overview, see this map.

metas.name: South Africa - Agriculture - Vineyards
metas.note: Vineyards are almost exclusively found in Western Cape, mostly in valleys near the coast. You can also commonly find them near Upington, in Northern Cape.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Banana
metas.note: Banana plants are found around the city of Alanya.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Cotton
metas.note: Cotton is mainly found in the region surrounding the city of Şanlıurfa.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Greenhouse
metas.note: If you find yourself surrounded by greenhouses, you are likely to be along the south coast west of Adana.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Olive
metas.note: Olive trees are mainly found on the Mediterranean coast.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Sunflower
metas.note: Sunflowers are mainly found in northwestern Turkey.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Tea
metas.note: Tea plantations are common in the province of Rize.

metas.name: Turkey - Agriculture - Vineyard
metas.note: A majority of all vineyards in Turkey can be found in a region east of Izmir.

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Canola
metas.note: Along the Canadian border in North Dakota, and rarely Montana, fields filled with short yellow canola flowers (Brassica napus) can commonly be seen from the road.

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Center Pivot Irrigation
metas.note:
You may have noticed some difference between farmland in different states on satellite view… It can be difficult to tell the farmland apart unless you’re at a corner up close, but as it turns out, the circles are actually created by a giant machine you can see from a distance

This is called centre point irrigation and can be found in many regions in the country!!

The most common states are Idaho, Nebraska and Kansas
metas.footer: Source: UNITED STATES CENTRE PIVOT IRRIGAITON GUIDE

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Corn
metas.note:
Corn fields can most commonly be found in these regions:-Iowa

-North of Iowa

-Nebraska without NW

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Cotton
metas.note: Cotton is a crop that produces large fields of fluffy white flowers. It is most commonly produced in coastal Southeast States, the Lower Mississippi River Valley, Western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona.

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Golden Fields
metas.note:
Agricultural golden fields can commonly be seen in eastern Washington.

NOTE: Flat areas of northern and eastern Oregon can have a similar appearance.

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Rice
metas.note: Rice production only occurs in a few areas of the US, so it is very useful for region guessing. It is typically grown in large, flat fields that resemble low prairies. It is only grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi River Valley in Arkansas, Louisiana, Texas, and Mississippi.

metas.name: United States - Agriculture - Soy
metas.note: Soybeans are short, dark green crops organised in long rows and are found in similar regions where corn is grown. They are most common in the Eastern Plains, Midwest, Lower Mississippi Valley, and areas of the Mid Atlantic.
